topic: Searching for Students for Fee Collection
summary: This topic details the various methods available to efficiently search for a specific student before initiating the fee collection process.
steps: In the search bar, enter the student's name, registration number, father's name, or phone number.
The system will display matching student records.
Select the correct student from the search results to proceed with fee collection.
business_rules: Multiple search criteria are available to ensure accurate student identification.
important_notes: Basic student details will be displayed on the interface to help verify the student before selection.
